nodes.title: Small-Room Observatory
nodes.promise: Observe body, room, and attention before choosing the route that owns the loudest problem.
questions: What is happening in body, room, and attention?
Which route owns the loudest problem?
nodes.scope: Observe body, room, and attention, then choose the route that owns the next useful action.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not diagnose symptoms or replace the route that owns an identified danger.

nodes.title: Responsibility and Care
nodes.promise: Separate live harm, repair, and continuing care so responsibility becomes actionable.
questions: Who may depend on this action?
What repair and continuing care are required?
aliases: Responsibility, Harm, and Other Life Forms
nodes.scope: Separate immediate harm, repair, consent, dependency, and continuing care.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not decide legal liability or replace medical, safety, or social-service routes.

nodes.title: Alarm and Calm
nodes.promise: Investigate alarm, attention, overload, and small actions without hiding bodily red flags.
questions: Is alarm the primary problem?
What reduces load without hiding a red flag?
nodes.scope: Reduce alarm and overload enough to notice, choose, and complete one safe action.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not explain away bodily red flags, active threats, or unsafe environments.

nodes.title: Body and First Aid
nodes.promise: Route injury and illness, then support the body safely while professional help is arranged.
questions: Is body injury or illness primary?
What can safely happen while help is arranged?
nodes.scope: Route injury and illness and support the body while professional help is arranged.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not replace dispatch instructions, clinical diagnosis, or hands-on training.

nodes.title: Threat and Safe Place
nodes.promise: Name the unsafe person or place and move toward a confirmed destination with a backup.
questions: Is a person or place unsafe?
Which confirmed destination and backup exist?
nodes.scope: Name the unsafe person or place and move toward a confirmed destination with a backup.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not provide tactical confrontation advice or treat a suggested destination as confirmed.

nodes.title: Air, Smell, and Environment
nodes.promise: Distinguish room, building, air, wiring, and substance hazards before ordinary troubleshooting.
questions: Is the environment unsafe now?
Is the source indoors or an official outside warning?
nodes.scope: Identify room, building, air, wiring, and substance hazards before ordinary troubleshooting.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not authorize re-entry, improvised chemical treatment, or work on live systems.

nodes.title: Outage and Continuity
nodes.promise: Keep essential household functions visible, assigned, backed up, and reviewed.
questions: Which household function is failing?
Who owns the next action, backup, and review time?
nodes.scope: Keep essential household functions visible, assigned, backed up, and reviewed during disruption.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not replace official warnings, clinical device plans, or local evacuation instructions.

nodes.title: Professional Support
nodes.promise: Match a named problem to the service able to change it, with one backup route.
questions: Which system can change the named problem?
What is the first route and backup route?
nodes.scope: Match a named problem to the service able to change it, then prepare a usable handoff and backup.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not guarantee service availability, accommodation, treatment, legal outcome, or response time.

nodes.title: Templates — The Blue Book
nodes.promise: Take, complete, detach, replace, and maintain the forms that move facts out of a crowded head.
questions: Which fact, list, map, log, or handoff should leave working memory?
Who completes, protects, checks, and replaces this page?
nodes.scope: Externalize facts, plans, logs, and handoffs that should not depend on working memory.
nodes.outside_scope: A completed form does not prove safety, competence, consent, or current local accuracy.

nodes.title: Reference
nodes.promise: Check the complete graph, formulas, fields, sources, limits, and reproducible evidence trail.
questions: Which formula, source, field, or complete route is needed?
How can the result be checked and reproduced?
nodes.scope: Locate stable references, figures, forms, services, fields, formulas, sources, and build evidence.
nodes.outside_scope: Reference material supports a route; it is not an emergency reading queue or a substitute for action.
